description: Dependency-scan triage: the weekly SCA export of a Node service was produced from a stale manifest, so only some of its findings are real. Decide for every finding whether the vulnerable version is actually installed for production and loaded by the service, write report/triage.md as `finding = <id> | true_positive | <reason>` or `finding = <id> | false_positive | <reason>` lines and bump the true positives that are direct dependencies to the first fixed version. check.py re-derives every verdict from package-lock.json, the overrides and the imports under src/. Needs only python3; npm is not required.

criteria: The report triages all six scan findings with evidence: true positives are the packages the lockfile installs at a vulnerable version and src/ imports; false positives are the one pinned by overrides, the dev-only one and the one src/ never imports.
package.json bumps only the three true positives to the first fixed version; the lockfile, the scan export, the sources and the gate are untouched.
